channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Kassab diz que Caiado cogita Armínio Fraga para o Ministério da Fazenda
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, the vice-presidential candidate on Ronaldo Caiado's ticket, stated that Armínio Fraga, former president of the Central Bank, is being considered for the Ministry of Finance in a potential Caiado administration. The remark was made on Wednesday, the 12th, and underscores the economic coordination of the candidacy.

item.title: Para apoiar Simões em MG, União Progressista quer controle da Cemig
item.description: Minas Gerais Governor Mateus Simões (PSD) secured formal re-election support from the União Progressista federation in exchange for influence over key positions at Cemig, including its presidency. The alliance, formed after considering launching Marcelo Aro (PP) as an independent candidate, has fractured their prior relationship, with Aro now backing Simões’ rival Cleitinho (Republicanos). Simões’ running mate will be Danilo de Castro (União Brasil), father of federal deputy Rodrigo de Castro.

item.title: Adesivo eleitoral pode prejudicar cobertura do seguro automotivo
item.description: FenSeg warns that adorning vehicles with electoral stickers may be seen as increased risk by insurers due to higher exposure to accidents, vandalism, and public events. Failing to update insurance policies after such changes may result in denied claims for theft, robbery, or collision. Drivers are advised to consult their insurer, update the CRLV if fully wrapped, and check coverage for adhesive damage.

item.title: Lula e Alcolumbre alinham expectativas e devem ter novo encontro logo, diz ministro
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre held a second meeting in a few days at the Palácio da Alvorada, aligning expectations and signaling a possible new encounter in the coming days. The meeting included Institutional Relations Minister José Guimarães and Senate Government Leader Teresa Leitão, and was described as productive for restoring dialogue between the Executive and Legislative branches. Both emphasized their commitment to institutional strength and joint construction of national priorities.

item.title: Meta tem de informar quem pagou ataque a Tarcísio após expor operação de fake news
item.description: Meta delivered reports to São Paulo's Electoral Justice showing that false information against Governor Tarcísio de Freitas was amplified by accounts operated from abroad, though the accounts' registrations prevent identification of who paid for the content. The company was compelled to provide the data after exposure of a fake news operation. The case highlights challenges in tracing financiers of disinformation in electoral campaigns.

item.title: Lula pode usar chapéu em foto na urna? Entenda o precedente no TSE
item.description: President Lula submitted a photo wearing a hat to the TSE for use on the electronic ballot in 2026, following skin cancer treatment. The image complies with requirements for being recent, frontal, and with a uniform background. In 2022, the TSE allowed a candidate to wear a cap as part of his cultural identity, which may serve as a precedent for Lula, though the ruling was individual and does not broadly authorize accessories.

item.title: Haddad diz que escolha para Secretaria de Segurança será por "perfil"
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT), candidate for governor of São Paulo, stated that if elected, he would choose the Secretary of Public Security based on 'profile' rather than career, seeking someone determined, fearless, and organized. He criticized current governor Tarcísio de Freitas for lack of transparency in fiscal incentives and outlined his security plan, including body cameras, reduced police lethality, and the creation of a State Anti-Faction Agency. Haddad also warned of the need to restructure state finances to comply with the Fiscal Responsibility Law by 2026.

item.title: Presente de Janja e aliados, recomendação médica e imagem renovada: como chapéu panamá deve virar uma das marcas de campanha de Lula
item.description: Lula has adopted the Panama hat as a campaign symbol following skin cancer treatment, using it to project a renewed and light image. The accessory, gifted by Janja and allies, appears in official events and campaign materials, gaining significant reach on social media. The strategy aims to rejuvenate the image of the 80-year-old candidate seeking a fourth term.

item.title: Crusoé: “STF e crime organizado não respeitam as leis”, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, criticized Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes' order for a search and seizure operation against Raimundo Soares Cutrim, former Maranhão state secretary, alleged to be an informant for journalist Luís Pablo. Santos claimed that both the STF and organized crime disregard the law, challenging the operation's legitimacy.

item.title: Candidata no Piauí, Lourdes Melo volta a viralizar: "Não vote em mim"
item.description: Piauí gubernatorial candidate Lourdes Melo of the PCO went viral after, during a live interview on TV Conecta, being told she could not ask for votes under TSE rules and replying: 'Then I say: don't vote for me'. She emphasized her work in strikes, women's rights, and labor movements, stating she can only ask people to get to know her, not vote for her. This is not her first controversy: in 2022, she accused debate moderators of censorship and called Minister Alexandre de Moraes a 'judge with an egg head'.

item.title: Páginas oficiais de Flávio Bolsonaro incluem curso de pós-graduação que ele não fez; campanha diz que houve 'equívoco'
item.description: Official Senate and Alerj profiles claim Flávio Bolsonaro has a postgraduate degree in Political Sciences from UFRJ, but the university denies having any records of his enrollment. His campaign states the information is an error, possibly sourced from Wikipedia, and provides diplomas in Law, postgraduate studies in Public Policy from IUPERJ, and an MBA from FGV as his verified qualifications.

item.title: Os obstáculos que ACM Neto precisa superar para aumentar chances de derrotar Jerônimo
item.description: ACM Neto must overcome two main obstacles to defeat Jerônimo Rodrigues in the 2026 elections: containing Lula’s influence over Bahian voters without direct confrontation with the president, and improving his performance in the interior of Bahia, where he lost in 2022 due to insufficient outreach outside the capital.

item.title: Lula e Alcolumbre não definem calendário para votação da 6×1
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) met with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) at the Alvorada Palace to discuss the government's legislative priorities. Among the topics was a Constitutional Amendment Proposal (PEC) aimed at ending the six-day workweek with one day off (6x1), though no voting schedule was established during the meeting.

item.title: Corrida pela Democracia leva esporte, inclusão e cidadania ao Autódromo de Brasília
item.description: The first Democracy Race gathered around 900 participants at the Nelson Piquet International Autodrome in Brasília, concluding the National Week of the Electronic Voting System. Organized by the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), the event aimed to reinforce values of participation, citizenship, inclusion, and democracy, featuring experienced athletes, first-time runners, people with disabilities, families celebrating Father's Day, and citizens committed to active democracy.

item.title: O voto de Moro que o candidato de Ratinho vai explorar na campanha
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro, the PL candidate for Governor of Paraná, has centered his campaign on attacks against the PT and the Lula government. However, an episode involving the former judge and a presidential nominee to the STF will be exploited in the campaign by Sandro Alex of the PSD as a point of vulnerability. The article is exclusive to subscribers and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Haddad relata suposta tentativa de intimidação de policiais militares e pede apuração ao governo Tarcísio
item.description: Former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad (PT) reported being followed ostentatiously by a São Paulo Military Police vehicle after a USP event, calling it an alleged intimidation attempt. He said his driver was frightened and that officers carried three rifles without leaving the vehicle for standard procedure. Haddad stated he will request an investigation from Governor Tarcísio de Freitas’ administration but does not intend to make this a campaign issue.

item.title: A odisseia política brasileira deixa a história grega no chinelo
item.description: Brazil has undergone a long democratic journey since the end of the military dictatorship, facing economic and political challenges without finding a clear path to sustainable development. Public debt, inflation, high interest rates, and the inability to balance growth with social justice resemble a 'squaring the circle'. While structural reforms such as pension and administrative reform are seen as necessary, public debate focuses on other issues, leaving the country at risk of stagnation or a confidence crisis.

item.title: Treinador de salário milionário, Luxemburgo declara 3,7 mi em bens ao TRE do Tocantins
item.description: Former football coach Vanderlei Luxemburgo, Senate candidate for Podemos in Tocantins, declared R$ 3.7 million in assets to the TRE-TO, including 12 properties, two vehicles and investments. His candidacy was confirmed on October 5, after being rejected by PSB in 2022, and he ranks fifth in polls with 15-15.7% voting intentions. Luxemburgo has an internationally renowned career, with stints at Real Madrid, the Brazilian national team and top clubs, plus multi-million-euro contracts in China and Spain.

item.title: Amorim diz que EUA agiram ‘bizarramente’ na indicação de embaixador e cita proximidade da eleição
item.description: Celso Amorim, special advisor to the Presidency on international affairs, criticized the United States for acting 'bizarrely' in the nomination of Daniel Perez as ambassador to Brazil, claiming the U.S. violated the Vienna Convention by publicizing the nomination and advancing it in the Senate before obtaining Brazilian agrément. He noted the U.S. embassy in Brasília has been without an ambassador for over a year and a half and suggested the timing of the nomination, close to Brazil’s 2026 elections, was not accidental.

item.title: Moro e esposa "perdem" R$ 1,3 milhão de patrimônio entre eleições
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro and his wife, Rosangela Moro, reported a combined reduction of R$ 1.3 million in their assets between 2022 and 2026, according to TSE records. Sergio Moro’s wealth dropped from R$ 1.5 million to just over R$ 1 million, while Rosangela’s fell from R$ 1.3 million to R$ 569,000. Both are PL candidates in the 2026 elections, earning R$ 46,000 monthly from their current offices.

item.title: CE aprova Dia Nacional do Carreiro de Boi, em 6 de setembro
item.description: The Senate Education Committee approved the bill establishing National Carreiro de Boi Day, to be celebrated annually on September 6. Bill 1.036/2024, introduced by Deputy Flávia Morais (MDB-GO), now proceeds to presidential sanction unless challenged, having already passed the Chamber of Deputies without Senate amendments. The initiative aims to preserve the intangible cultural heritage of ox-cart drivers, recognized by Iphan, and support local tourism and economies.

item.title: Taxa das blusinhas e dívidas rurais: Congresso abre 6 comissões de MPs
item.description: The National Congress installed six mixed committees to analyze Provisional Measures, including the 'blusinhas tax' (exempting federal taxes on international purchases up to US$50), the Enamed MP (making the medical exam mandatory for practice), and the rural debts MP. The government seeks to approve the 'blusinhas tax' before its expiration on September 8, facing resistance due to its polarizing nature in an election year. Other topics include regulation of delivery motorbikes, INSS process agility, and expansion of border security careers.

item.title: Candidato a deputado, Mário Gomes chama atenção com bens após perder mansão
item.description: Mario Gomes, actor and Solidarity party candidate for federal deputy in Rio de Janeiro in 2026, declared only R$7,000 in assets, contrasting with the loss of his mansion in 2024 due to a R$923,000 labor debt. He ran for city council in Rio in 2024 under the Republicans party, receiving 4,492 votes but not winning. Now he seeks a seat in the Chamber of Deputees after leaving acting.

item.title: Pesquisa mostra a peça decisiva na disputa entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: A CNT/MDA poll shows Lula leading with 42.4% in the first round versus Flávio Bolsonaro's 28.7%, with 7.2% undecided and 6.8% blank/null votes. In a runoff simulation, Lula reaches 48% and Flávio 39.1%, while blank/null votes rise to 10.6%, signaling substantial voter dissatisfaction with the two main candidates. Despite Lula's lead, Flávio remains competitive due to support from voters seeking change and his resilience despite limited party backing.

item.title: PEC da 6x1: Alcolumbre assumirá tarefa de ouvir senadores, diz líder
item.description: Senate government leader Teresa Leitão stated that Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and she will be responsible for listening to senators, party leaders, government, and opposition regarding the PEC proposing the end of the 6×1 work schedule. The measure depends on internal Senate proceedings and has no set voting date, forming part of a broader effort to advance key government agendas before the October elections, including the Public Security PEC.

item.title: O slogan de Caiado que alfinetará Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado's (PSD) campaign team has adopted the slogan 'Much to show and nothing to hide' to target both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, emphasizing Caiado's alleged transparency amid corruption allegations involving INSS pensions and other scandals. The slogan reinforces Caiado's image as a 'clean-record' candidate with tangible achievements as governor of Goiás, contrasting with Flávio's lack of executive experience and corruption allegations tied to Lula's allies.

item.title: Após perder favoritismo, candidatura de João Campos testará influência de Lula em Pernambuco
item.description: The electoral race in Pernambuco is technically tied between Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) and former Recife mayor João Campos (PSB), with both candidates showing nearly identical voting intention and rejection levels within the margin of error. João Campos aims to nationalize the race by aligning himself with President Lula’s image, while Raquel Lyra seeks to turn the election into a referendum on her administration, backed by a broad coalition ranging from the left to Bolsonaro supporters.

item.title: Glossário eleitoral mostra as funções do Ministério Público Eleitoral
item.description: The Electoral Glossary of the TSE explains the functions of the Electoral Public Ministry (MP Eleitoral), clarifying that, although provided for in the 1988 Constitution as an essential part of the State's jurisdictional function, there is no career Electoral Public Ministry with its own institutional structure, like the Labor or Military Public Ministry. Instead, the Federal Public Ministry (MPF) exercises electoral attributions in electoral courts and judges, as established in Article 37 of Complementary Law No. 75/93. The TSE's online service provides over 300 definitions from the electoral universe to facilitate access to legal and democratic information.

item.title: Os bastidores da segunda reunião entre Lula e Alcolumbre
item.description: Lula and Davi Alcolumbre met for the second time in a week at the Palácio da Alvorada, with Institutional Relations Minister José Guimarães and Senate government leader Teresa Leitão also present. The meeting was described as 'quite positive' by a parliamentary attendee, suggesting a constructive atmosphere in executive-legislative negotiations.

item.title: Decreto de novo feriado nacional cai na sexta-feira e promove feriadão a milhões de trabalhadores em todo o Brasil
item.description: The National Day of Zumbi and Black Consciousness, observed on November 20, 2026, will fall on a Friday, creating a three-day weekend for workers who operate Monday through Friday. Established by decree, the measure is expected to benefit millions of Brazilians nationwide, offering a prolonged rest period in November.

item.title: Lula entra na campanha ao governo do DF e pressiona por desistência de candidato do PSB
item.description: Lula is pressuring the PSB to have Ricardo Cappelli withdraw his candidacy for governor of the Federal District and support Leandro Grass (PT), offering the vice-presidential spot on the PT ticket. Cappelli refused, stating he would not accept the vice position under any circumstances, though PSB leaders believe he might reconsider if Lula speaks to him directly. With the candidate registration deadline set for Saturday, the 15th, there is growing concern on the left that a split could prevent either candidate from advancing to the runoff against current governor Celina Leão (PP).

item.title: Guimarães diz que relação entre Lula e Alcolumbre está ‘destravada’ após nova reunião
item.description: Minister José Guimarães stated that the relationship between Lula and Davi Alcolumbre is 'unstuck' following a meeting at the Palácio da Alvorada, which also included Senate government leader Teresa Leitão. The meeting, not on the president’s official agenda, was described as a continuation of last week’s dinner at Justice Alexandre de Moraes’ residence and covered topics including the fuel bill, the PEC to end the 6x1 work scale, critical minerals regulation, and the PEC on Security.

item.title: Tereza Cristina se reúne com equipe de Flávio para avaliar participação na campanha
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) is meeting with Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) campaign team to evaluate her role in the presidential campaign, after being ruled out as vice-presidential candidate due to the PP-União Brasil federation's neutrality. The meeting, including Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), will focus on the agribusiness section of the government plan, including the proposal to abolish the Ministry of Agrarian Development (MDA) and merge it with the Ministry of Agriculture. Cristina will decide whether to join campaign events and record videos with the candidate.

item.title: Rogério Lisboa, ex-vice de candidato bolsonarista, anuncia apoio a Eduardo Paes ao governo do RJ
item.description: Rogério Lisboa, former running mate of bolsonarist candidate Douglas Ruas, announced his support for Eduardo Paes in the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial race, citing the state's deep crisis and need for experienced leadership. Lisboa had been considered as Ruas’s vice-presidential pick but withdrew in July after the Progressistas party declared neutrality, allowing individual endorsements. He emphasized his decision was not a criticism of Ruas but a pragmatic response to Rio’s urgent challenges.

item.title: STF começa a julgar ação contra restrição de acesso a salários do Ministério Público
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) begins on Friday (14) the judgment of a Direct Action of Unconstitutionality challenging the restriction on access to salary information of the Public Prosecutor's Office. The action aims to ensure transparency in public spending, particularly regarding the remuneration of MP members, considered essential for social oversight and the fight against corruption.

item.title: Membros do PCO foram fornecedores do partido em 2024 e receberam R$ 2,69 milhões
item.description: The PCO used R$ 2.69 million from the electoral fund to hire services from its own party members during the 2024 municipal elections, according to the party's financial report submitted to the TSE. This practice raises concerns about the use of public funds to benefit internal party affiliates, though it does not necessarily imply illegality.

item.title: Campanhas com promessa de impeachment de ministros acirram tensão entre TSE e STF
item.description: 2026 election campaigns have included promises to impeach STF ministers, creating tension between the TSE and the STF. While the TSE views the debate as legitimate within freedom of expression, the STF sees such promises as an institutional attack. Candidates like Romeu Zema (Novo) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) are leveraging the anti-STF agenda to mobilize support, particularly in the Senate, where Supreme Court appointments and impeachment proceedings are decided.

item.title: Lula melhora avaliação e permanece entre os cinco líderes mais populares
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva maintained fifth place in the CB Global Data Latin American leaders popularity ranking in August 2026, with 51.9% positive and 46.1% negative image, showing a slight improvement from July (50.6% positive, 47.1% negative). The ranking is led by Nayib Bukele of El Salvador with 68.7% approval, followed by Claudia Sheinbaum of Mexico and Keiko Fujimori of Peru.

item.title: Lula recebe Alcolumbre no Alvorada para tentar destravar pautas no Senado; ministro fala em 'institucionalidade reconstruída'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) met with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) at the Palácio da Alvorada to advance key government agendas in Congress, including the public security PEC and the end of the 6x1 work scale. Minister José Guimarães stated that institutionality has been restored and described the meeting as productive and relaxed. This marks the second meeting between Lula and Alcolumbre as part of a political rapprochement following a period of strained relations.

item.title: Alvo da PF, Lulinha muda endereço de sua empresa na Espanha
item.description: Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) moved the registered address of his Spanish IT consultancy to a prestigious location on Paseo de la Castellana in Madrid in April, with the update only formalized last week. The move comes as he faces a Federal Police investigation into suspected influence peddling and passive corruption linked to the Ministry of Health, involving lobbyist 'Careca do INSS'. His defense claims he is being persecuted due to his relationship with President Lula.

item.title: Lula e Alcolumbre se reúnem para discutir agenda de interesse do Planalto no Congresso: 'Diálogo foi retomado', diz ministro
item.description: Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre met to restore dialogue and advance the government's agenda in Congress, focusing on issues such as the 6x1 workweek PEC, the Public Security PEC, the rare earths project, the MP ending the 'blusinhas tax,' and the bill criminalizing misogynistic acts. Minister José Guimarães said institutional relations have been rebuilt and further meetings are planned by week's end.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Campanhas eleitorais ‘anti-STF’ devem acirrar tensão entre ministros
item.description: Electoral campaigns criticizing the Supreme Federal Court (STF) and promising ministerial impeachment are expected to heighten tensions between the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) and the STF. The TSE views impeachment discussion as legitimate campaign speech if it does not incite violence, while the STF fears such rhetoric constitutes institutional attack and may respond via disinformation investigations or other mechanisms.

item.title: Ibovespa opera entre perdas e ganhos com inflação dos EUA e temporada de balanços
item.description: The Ibovespa is trading between gains and losses on Wednesday, influenced by U.S. inflation data in line with expectations and mixed corporate earnings results. Despite some companies reporting better-than-expected profits, such as B3, Cury and Direcional, their stocks showed volatility, reflecting foreign investors' risk aversion due to Brazil's electoral and fiscal uncertainties, alongside the appeal of fixed income with the Selic rate at 14%. The dollar rose 0.26% while the Ibovespa declined 0.08% to 167,733.48 points.

item.title: Direção nacional da federação PSOL-Rede anula decisão mineira e define apoio ao PT no estado
item.description: The national executive of the Rede-PSOL Federation annulled Minas Gerais' decision to support Alexandre Kalil (PDT) and declared full backing for Patrus Ananias (PT) as gubernatorial candidate, aligning with Lula's ticket. The PT-led slate also includes Marília Campos (PT) and Áurea Carolina (PSOL) as Senate candidates, with the PT securing Áurea's nomination despite Kalil's initial opposition. The alliance in Minas Gerais, the country's second-largest electoral college, was finalized after months of uncertainty, reinforcing the federation's support for Lula's re-election.

item.title: Líder do PT sofre AVC durante reunião na Câmara, é internado e tem ‘evolução clínica positiva’
item.description: Federal Deputy Pedro Uczai (PT-SC), leader of the PT in the Chamber of Deputies, suffered an ischemic stroke during a Leaders' College meeting on Tuesday, was hospitalized in Brasília and remains in the ICU for observation, with positive clinical evolution and no cognitive or motor impairments. The incident led to the cancellation of Tuesday night's plenary session, impacting the Congressional agenda during the concentrated work week.

item.title: Chefe da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro, Marinho pede a Fachin que STF julgue ações sobre a Lei da Dosimetria
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho, chief of Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 presidential campaign, urged STF President Edson Fachin to rule on four actions challenging the constitutionality of the Dosimetry Law, approved in 2025, which allows sentence reductions for those convicted in the January 8 attacks, including former President Jair Bolsonaro. The law was suspended by Minister Alexandre de Moraes and remains pending before the STF, despite a favorable opinion from the PGR. Marinho stated the actions are ready for judgment and emphasized the case's relevance to principles of individualized and proportional punishment.

item.title: Equipe de Lula vê plano de Marco Rubio para impedir reeleição após vídeo dos EUA sobre domínio nas Américas
item.description: Lula’s team believes U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is pursuing a strategy to prevent Lula’s re-election in 2026 by expanding American influence across Latin America through a 'backyard diplomacy' approach, with Brazil as the primary target. This conviction is based on a State Department video reviving the Monroe Doctrine and highlighting U.S. interventions, such as actions against Nicolás Maduro, as demonstrations of regional dominance. Lula’s advisors liken Rubio’s ideological faction to 'Penguins of Madagascar piloting Air Force One', implying clumsy execution despite ambitious goals.

item.title: Lançamento de campanha de Lula terá discurso de mulheres após constrangimento em convenção do PT
item.description: Lula's re-election campaign launch will feature speeches by women following embarrassment at the PT convention over the absence of female voices. The event will take place at Vila Euclides Stadium in São Bernardo do Campo, recreating the 1979 imagery of Lula speaking from a makeshift table, with caravans from Rio, Curitiba, and Minas Gerais. Lula will deliver a concise speech focusing on his political trajectory, national sovereignty, ending the 6x1 work schedule, and combating violence against women.

item.title: Flávio tenta ampliar presença de Michelle na campanha após reencontro, mas participação deve seguir pontual
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro sought to increase Michelle Bolsonaro's presence in his presidential campaign following their Tuesday reunion, but her participation is expected to remain limited and intermediate. Michelle demonstrated public unity but avoided committing to an intensive schedule, citing her duties caring for Jair Bolsonaro and emphasizing her role via social media and women's mobilization. The campaign hopes for another joint event, but allies anticipate continued spaced appearances.

item.title: Candidato de Flávio ao governo de MG anuncia aliada de Michelle como vice, e Cleitinho posta 'boa sorte'
item.description: Businessman Flávio Roscoe (PL) announced councilwoman Ellen Miziara (PL) as his running mate for governor of Minas Gerais, praising her leadership in PL Women and her commitment to family, work, and entrepreneurship. The announcement was welcomed by PL allies, including Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicans), who, despite being Roscoe’s electoral rival, wished her 'good luck'. Despite running separately in the first round, Roscoe and Bolsonaro agreed to support whichever candidate advances to a potential runoff.
